facts.text: Chip, mind your manners, we have a guest. Tea first, tart next. The Beast can wait, and so can the dishes.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a line Mrs Potts says. The quote page I tried only held stage directions, so no source could be opened to prove it, but it matches nothing in the film's plot or songs.
facts.fix: Chip, mind your manners, we have a guest. Tea first, tart after, and the Beast can wait.
